title: Asset - Data API
description: Represents an item of commercial value, such as a product sold by your company or a competitor, that a customer has purchased.

AccountId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
AccountId.description: (Required) ID of the Account associated with this asset. Must be a valid account ID. Required if ContactId isn’t specified. This field is a relationship field.

Address.description: Represents the physical address or geolocation of the asset.

AssetLevel.description: The asset’s position in an asset hierarchy. If the asset has no parent or child assets, its level is 1. Assets that belong to a hierarchy have a level of 1 for the root asset, 2 for the child assets of the root asset, 3 for their children, and so forth. On assets created before the introduction of this field, the asset level defaults to –1. After the asset record is updated, the asset level is calculated and automatically updated.

AssetProvidedById.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
AssetProvidedById.description: The account that provided the asset, typically a manufacturer. This field is a relationship field.

AssetServicedById.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
AssetServicedById.description: The account in charge of servicing the asset. This field is a relationship field.

AssetTypeId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
AssetTypeId.description: The asset type associated with the asset. This field is a relationship field. This field is available in API version 62.0 and later for users with the Health Cloud Appointment Management permission set.

Availability.description: The percentage of expected uptime where the asset was available for use.

AveragetimetoRepair.description: Represents the number of hours it typically takes to repair an asset after a failure.

AveragetimeBetweenFailure.description: Represents the number of hours that typically elapses before the asset is likely to fail again.

AverageUptimePerDay.description: The average number of hours per day the asset is expected to be available for use.

City.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
City.description: The city detail for the address.

ConsequenceOfFailure.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ConsequenceOfFailure.description: The business impact associated with the asset’s failure. Using this field, you can address the asset’s health and take action using Flows. To enable this field, use Object Manager to update the field availability. Make sure that the field is visible for field-level security and for page layout. To learn more, see What Determines Field Access. The picklist values aren’t predefined in orgs created before Winter ’22 that aren’t Field Service enabled. This field is available in API version 53.0 and later. Possible values are: Insignificant Minor Moderate Major Critical

ContactId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ContactId.description: Required if AccountId isn’t specified. ID of the Contact associated with this asset. Must be a valid contact ID that has an account parent (but doesn’t need to match the asset’s AccountId). This field is a relationship field.

Country.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Country.description: The country detail for the address.

CurrencyIsoCode.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CurrencyIsoCode.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code associated with the invoice. The default value is USD. This field is available in API version 55.0 and later. This field is available when CPQ Plus, Salesforce Billing, or Revenue Cloud is enabled.

CurrentAmount.description: Reserved for future use. This field is available in API version 50.0 and later. This field is available when CPQ Plus, Salesforce Billing, or Revenue Cloud is enabled.

CurrentLifecycleEndDate.description: Represents the end of the period shown as current. System-populated field inherited from the end date of the current asset state period. If that field is empty, as with an evergreen subscription, the Current Lifecycle End Date field is also empty. This field is available in API version 50.0 and later. This field is available when CPQ Plus, Salesforce Billing, or Revenue Cloud is enabled.

CurrentMrr.description: The asset’s monthly recurring revenue during the current asset state period. System-populated field inherited from the monthly recurring revenue on the current asset state period. If no asset state period is current, the value is 0. Label is Current Monthly Recurring Revenue. This field is available in API version 50.0 and later. This field is available when CPQ Plus, Salesforce Billing, or Revenue Cloud is enabled.

CurrentQuantity.description: The asset’s quantity during the current asset state period. System-populated field inherited from the quantity on the current asset state period. If no asset state period is current, the value is 0. This field is available in API version 50.0 and later. This field is available when CPQ Plus, Salesforce Billing, or Revenue Cloud is enabled.

DigitalAssetStatus.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DigitalAssetStatus.description: Status of digital tracking of the asset. The default picklist includes the following values: On Off Warning: Error

ExternalIdentifier.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ExternalIdentifier.description: The ID of the matching record in an external system. This field is available in API version 49.0 and later.

GeocodeAccuracy.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
GeocodeAccuracy.description: Accuracy level of the geocode for the address.

HasLifecycleManagement.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
HasLifecycleManagement.description: True if this asset is a lifecycle-managed asset, otherwise false. You can’t switch an asset to a lifecycle-managed asset or the reverse. This field is system populated. The default value is false.This field is available in API version 50.0 and later. This field is available when CPQ Plus, Salesforce Billing, or Revenue Cloud is enabled.

InstallDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
InstallDate.description: Date when the asset was installed.

IsCompetitorProduct.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsCompetitorProduct.description: Indicates whether this Asset represents a product sold by a competitor (true) or not (false). The default value is false. Its UI label is Competitor Asset.

IsInternal.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsInternal.description: Indicates that the asset is produced or used internally (true) or not (false). The default value is false. Its UI label is Internal Asset.

LastReferencedDate.description: The date and time that the asset was last modified. Its UI label is Last Modified Date.

LastViewedDate.description: The date and time that the asset was last viewed.

Latitude.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Latitude.description: Used with Longitude to specify the precise geolocation of the address.

LifecycleEndDate.description: Represents the end of the asset’s lifecycle. System-populated field inherited from the end date of the final asset state period. If that field is empty, as with an evergreen subscription, the lifecycle has no end date. This field is available in API version 50.0 and later. This field is available when CPQ Plus, Salesforce Billing, or Revenue Cloud is enabled.

LifecycleStartDate.description: Represents the beginning of the asset’s lifecycle. System-populated field inherited from the start date of the earliest asset state period. This field can’t be edited. When a new asset action affects the start date of an asset state period, the period is deleted and a new one is generated. This field is available in API version 50.0 and later. This field is available when CPQ Plus, Salesforce Billing, or Revenue Cloud is enabled.

LocationId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
LocationId.description: The asset’s location. Typically, this location is the place where the asset is stored, such as a warehouse or van. If you have access to the location entity, it doesn’t necessarily mean you can access the location id field. To access the location, you must have userHasLocation user access.

Longitude.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Longitude.description: Used with Latitude to specify the precise geolocation of the address.

ManufactureDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ManufactureDate.description: The date when the asset was manufactured. This field is available from API version 49.0 and later.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: (Required) Name of the asset. Label is Asset Name.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The asset’s owner. By default, the asset owner is the user who created the asset record. Its UI label is Asset Owner. This field is a relationship field.

ParentId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ParentId.description: The asset’s parent asset. Its UI label is Parent Asset. This field is a relationship field.

PostalCode.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PostalCode.description: The postal code for the address.

PricingSource.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
PricingSource.description: Pricing source to use when amending or renewing an asset. Valid values are: LastTransaction—Last Transaction PriceBookListPrice—Price Book or List Price Available in API version 60.0 and later.

Product2Id.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Product2Id.description: (Optional) ID of the Product2 associated with this asset. Must be a valid Product2 ID. Its UI label is Product. This field is a relationship field.

ProductCode.description: The product code of the related product.

ProductDescription.description: The product description of the related product.

ProductFamily.description: The product family of the related product.

PurchaseDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PurchaseDate.description: Date on which this asset was purchased.

Quantity.description: Quantity purchased or installed. The Quantity field value isn’t set by Customer Asset Lifecycle Management. Instead, you can populate the field as you need.

QuantityIncreasePricingType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
QuantityIncreasePricingType.description: Specify which pricing type to use when the quantity of this asset is increased. Its UI label is Pricing Type for Quantity Increase. This field is available in API version 56.0 and later. This field is available when Revenue Cloud is enabled. Possible values are: LastNegotiatedPrice—Available in API version 58.0 and later. ListPrice

RecordTypeId.description: The unique identifier for the asset. This field is a relationship field.

Reliability.description: The percentage of expected uptime where the asset wasn’t subject to unplanned downtime.

RenewalPricingType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
RenewalPricingType.description: The price used when renewing a subscription. Its UI label is Pricing Type for Renewal. This field is available in API version 55.0 and later. This field is available when Revenue Cloud is enabled. Possible values are: LastNegotiatedPrice ListPrice

RenewalTerm.description: With Renewal Term Unit, defines the default subscription term for renewal quotes. This field is available in API version 55.0 and later. This field is available when Revenue Cloud is enabled.

RenewalTermUnit.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
RenewalTermUnit.description: The unit of time for a subscription term. This field is available in API version 55.0 and later. This field is available when Revenue Cloud is enabled. Possible values are: Annual—Available in API version 58.0 and later. —UI label is Years. Months

SalesStoreId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
SalesStoreId.description: ID of the RetailStore or WebStore associated with this Asset. This field is a polymorphic relationship field. To access this field, your org must have a Salesforce Order Management license or a B2B Commerce License. This field is available in API v60.0 and later.

SerialNumber.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

State.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
State.description: The state detail for the address.

Status.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Status.description: Customizable picklist of values. The default picklist includes the following values: Purchased Shipped Installed Registered Obsolete

StatusReason.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
StatusReason.description: The explanation of the device status. This field is available from API version 49.0 and later. Possible values are: Not Ready Off Offline Online Paused Standby

StockKeepingUnit.description: The SKU assigned to the related product.

Street.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Street.description: The street detail for the address.

SumDowntime.description: Accumulated downtime (planned and unplanned), determined as follows: When only UptimeRecordStart is set, the sum of all downtime from UptimeRecordStart When UptimeRecordStart and UptimeRecordEnd are set, the sum of all downtime from UptimeRecordStart to UptimeRecordEnd Otherwise, downtime isn’t accumulated.

SumUnplannedDowntime.description: Accumulated unplanned downtime, determined as follows: When only UptimeRecordStart is set, the sum of all unplanned downtime from UptimeRecordStart When UptimeRecordStart and UptimeRecordEnd are set, the sum of all unplanned downtime from UptimeRecordStart to UptimeRecordEnd Otherwise, unplanned downtime isn’t accumulated.

TotalLifecycleAmount.description: The total amount of revenue for the asset, including revenue from each stage in the asset lifecycle. This field is available when CPQ Plus, Salesforce Billing, or Revenue Cloud is enabled.

UptimeRecordEnd.description: The date until which SumDowntime and SumUnplannedDowntime are accumulated.

UptimeRecordStart.description: The date from which SumDowntime and SumUnplannedDowntime are accumulated.

UsageEndDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
UsageEndDate.description: Date when usage for this asset ends or expires.

Uuid.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Uuid.description: The unique ID for the asset. This field is available in API version 49.0 and later.

usage:
Use this object to track products sold to customers. With asset tracking, a client application can quickly determine which products were previously sold or are currently installed at a specific account. You can also create hierarchies of up to 10,000 assets. For example, suppose that your company wants to renew and upsell opportunities on products sold in the past. Similarly, your company can track competitive products in a customer environment where products can be replaced or swapped out. Asset tracking is also useful for product support, providing detailed information to assist with product-specific support issues. For example, the PurchaseDate or SerialNumber can indicate whether a given product has certain maintenance requirements, including product recalls. Similarly, the UsageEndDate can indicate when the asset was removed from service or when a license or warranty expires. If an application creates an Asset record, it must specify a Name and either an AccountId, ContactId, or both.

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, those objects are available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **AssetChangeEvent (API version 44.0)**: Change events are available for the object.
- **AssetFeed**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
- **AssetHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **AssetOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **AssetShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
